quote:

translation: Since October 2005 China had blocked access to Wikipedia, as the government routinely blocks sites it considers subversive and filters pages with sensitive terms.

translation: Among censorship measures so far, the blocks in the People's Republic of China between June 2004 and October 2006 were the most significant.

quote: La Chine bloque l'accès à Wikipédia dans toutes les langues en avril 2019, dans le cadre de la censure d'Internet dans ce pays.
translation: China blocked Wikipedia in all languages in April 2019, as part of internet censorship in that country.

quote: Access to Wikipedia has been blocked in mainland China since May 2015. This was done after Wikipedia started to use HTTPS encryption, which made selective censorship more difficult.
29 Nisan 2017'de Vikipedi'ye Türkiye'den erişim Bilgi Teknolojileri ve İletişim Kurumu tarafından idari tedbir uygulanmak suretiyle engellenmiştir.
translation: On 29 April 2017 access to Wikipedia from Turkey was blocked by the Information and Communication Technologies Authority by means of an administrative measure.

quote: خبرگزاری فرانسه به نقل از رسانه‌های دولتی ترکیه نوشته است که این محدودیت به دلیل ناموفق بودن ویکی‌پدیا در «حذف محتوای مشوق تروریسم و حاوی اتهام همکاری ترکیه با گروه‌های تروریستی» صورت گرفته است.
section: فیلترینگ و سانسور / قطع دسترسی به ویکی‌پدیا در ترکیه
translation: AFP, citing Turkish state media, wrote that the restriction was imposed because Wikipedia failed to 'remove content encouraging terrorism and accusing Turkey of cooperating with terrorist groups'.

quote: Hasan Gökkaya schrieb in der Wochenzeitung Die Zeit, dass die türkische Regierung den Wikipediabetreibern „Terrorpropaganda“ vorwerfe.
translation: Hasan Gökkaya wrote in Die Zeit that the Turkish government accused Wikipedia's operators of 'terror propaganda'.

quote: La Turquie bloque l'accès à Wikipédia le 29 avril 2017 en raison de la présence d'articles évoquant la possible collaboration entre le gouvernement turc et des organisations jihadistes actives en Syrie.
translation: Turkey blocked Wikipedia on 29 April 2017 because of articles discussing possible collaboration between the Turkish government and jihadist organisations active in Syria.

quote: С 29 апреля 2017 года по 15 января 2020 года Турция блокировала доступ к Википедии.
translation: From 29 April 2017 to 15 January 2020 Turkey blocked access to Wikipedia.

quote: 2 yıl 8 ay 17 gün aradan sonra (992 gün), 15 Ocak 2020 tarihinde Türkiye saati ile 22.30'da Anayasa Mahkemesi kararıyla yeniden erişime açılmıştır.
translation: After 2 years 8 months 17 days (992 days), it was reopened on 15 January 2020 at 22:30 Turkish time by Constitutional Court ruling.

quote: Le blocage est levé le 15 janvier 2020, jour de la publication de l'arrêt complet de la cour au Journal officiel, soit 991 jours après le début du blocage.
translation: The block was lifted on 15 January 2020, the day the court's full ruling was published in the Official Gazette, 991 days after the block began.

quote: Am 15. Januar 2001 war das Wiki der Nupedia unter der eigenständigen Adresse wikipedia.com abrufbar, was seither als die Geburtsstunde der Wikipedia gilt.
translation: On 15 January 2001 the Nupedia wiki became available at the separate address wikipedia.com, which has since been regarded as Wikipedia's birth.

quote: تم تسجيل النطاقات Wikipedia.com وWikipedia.org يوم 12 يناير 2001، و13 يناير 2001، على التوالي
translation: The domains Wikipedia.com and Wikipedia.org were registered on 12 January 2001 and 13 January 2001 respectively.

quote: 维基百科最早是在吉米·威爾斯與拉里·桑格兩人的合作下于2001年1月13日在網際網路上推出的網站服務，並于1月15日正式展開網路百科全書計畫。
translation: Wikipedia was first launched online as a website service on 13 January 2001 through the cooperation of Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, and formally began the online encyclopedia project on 15 January.

quote: Wikipedia was launched on January 15, 2001 (sometimes referred to as "Wikipedia Day"), as a single English language edition with the domain name www.wikipedia.com, and was announced by Sanger on the Nupedia mailing list.
